name: Venom
description: Share projects, tasks, decisions and skills across your team's coding agents, so any agent or teammate can pick up where another left off.
notes: Uses Venom's hosted MCP server. OAuth is handled by the server via browser sign-in with Dynamic Client Registration and PKCE, so no client ID, client secret or API key is required. The user picks their Venom organization during sign-in.
installHint: Sign in to Venom through the browser OAuth flow when prompted and pick your organization; no client credentials or API key are needed.
